name: prisoners-dilemma
description: Iterated prisoner's dilemma. Players never act on each other directly: each one writes its move to the context, and a rule settles the round.

temptation.description: T: payoff for defecting against a cooperator

sucker.description: S: payoff for cooperating against a defector

moves.description: Moves of the current round, keyed by agent id. Each agent writes only its own key, so writes never conflict.

cooperationRate.description: Share of cooperative moves in the last settled round

opponent.description: Who plays against whom this round; set by the matchmaking rule

greed.description: Temptation to exploit an opponent who has been trusting

grudge.description: How strongly being betrayed reduces cooperation

betrayed.description: Rounds in which this player cooperated and the opponent defected

opponentMoves.description: Last moves of this player's opponents

cooperate.description: Play C. The propensity drops as the share of betrayals in memory grows, weighted by grudge.

defect.description: Play D. The propensity is computed in Lua: dishonesty, plus greed when the opponent has been trusting, plus resentment after betrayals.
